environment.description: Same application binary deployed inside a gVisor (runsc) sandboxed container on GKE Autopilot with a SecurityContext specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem. The pod runs under a dedicated ServiceAccount with no cluster roles. The container's root filesystem is mounted from a distroless base image with pivot_root applied at /app. Process namespace isolation (shareProcessNamespace: false) is enabled. The node pool has Shielded GKE Nodes with integrity monitoring. A Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and an internal PostgreSQL service on port 5432 — all other egress including outbound HTTP/HTTPS to external hosts is denied. The Istio sidecar proxy enforces mTLS STRICT mode on all mesh traffic with an AuthorizationPolicy requiring JWT validation with audience claim matching 'search-api-internal'. The container filesystem is confined via pivot_root to /app containing only the application binary, the dotnet runtime, and an empty /app/data directory — no /etc/passwd, no /proc/self/environ, no sensitive files exist within the chroot boundary.

config.filesystem_root: /app (pivot_root, contains only binary + runtime + empty data/)
